notes: Benchmarks the Hub model on the UNSEEN val split (training used only train/; test/ has no public ground truth). Writes benchmarks.json (overall + per-sequence mAP/mAR, latency percentiles, environment) to the kernel output and logs everything.

slug=null -> the kaggle service runner derives the kernel name from the <type>-<name> convention. Kernels live in a Kaggle collection named after the model (maintained in the UI — the API has no collections endpoint).

kernel_sources mounts the rtdetr-sportsmot-evaluation-prepare-data kernel's OUTPUT (sportsmot-val.tar, staged by evaluation/prepare-data); the launcher refuses to push while that kernel is not COMPLETE.
external-secrets provides HF_TOKEN (optional here — the model is public; only raises rate limits).
Run the sibling evaluation/smoketest first — a few minutes validating this exact environment.
